{{Otheruses|Peregrine}}
'''The Peregrine''' was an old [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] legend, centered around a ghostly figure. The ghost was supposedly the ghost of an old [[Gender/Legends|man]] who had been cursed to wander the world for eternity, never being able to find his home. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was told this story in his early life.<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'' to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref> Solo and his friend [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] heard the name of the [[Peregrine (Dreadnaught-class)|''Peregrine'']], a [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] which was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Corellian [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]' [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement|private army]], while traveling to the army's headquarters of [[Peregrine's Nest]]. He then told Calrissian that the name of the [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser]] was also the name of the Corellian legend, which he had heard when he was a child. Solo found the story "creepy."<ref name="DFR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Peregrine was mentioned in the [[1992]] novel ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'', the second installment in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''Thrawn Trilogy'']].<ref name="DFR" />
